items.title: Critical x402 SDK Flaw Could Let Malicious APIs Drain AI Agents’ Token Balances
items.summary: AI agents paying for API calls with the x402 SDKs could sign a payment for their full balance of a supported token if a malicious API asked for it, security firm V12 said on October 22.

items.title: Critical Flaw in Python’s Popular Pillow Image Library Allows Code Execution via a Crafted Image
items.summary: Pillow, the most widely used image library for Python, can be made to run operating system commands on a server by specifying the name of a file it is told to open.
